original_test_intent: Verify the BMC-visible inventory and health information for the intended storage devices, while preserving the source conflict over whether the procedure instead targets PCIe cards and what Number denotes.
original_method: After the owner resolves scope and field semantics, bind the documented read-only BMC records to storage bay/slot/serial/namespace and correlate them with same-host OS and controller inventory.
manual_activity: The owner must resolve the HDD/PCIe wording and Number field. An operator may then confirm bay/slot mapping or capture UI-only fields; automation can collect and compare read-only evidence.
required_inputs: Vendor storage schema and status vocabulary
safety_requirements: Never format, erase, mount, rebuild, reset or firmware-update storage
Bind each record to one physical/logical device
Stop on device disappearance or media/controller fault
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Do not execute until scope and Number are resolved
Collect raw BMC/UI and same-host OS/controller inventory
Correlate Name, Status and resolved Number per device
Report discrepancies without changing storage or deciding the verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve HDD versus PCIe and Number semantics
Supply schema, topology and expected inventory

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Completely inapplicable: CPU inlet-temperature assertions belong to duplicate row 770 and do not expose storage fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the engineering decision, use the documented read-only BMC storage path and same-host lsblk/nvme/controller evidence; never guess or run write-capable storage operations.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Name, Status, Number, the conflicting PCIe wording and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Once resolved, store raw records and a bay/slot/serial/namespace-keyed inventory and health comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the source contradiction explicit and adds deterministic device correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No branch is silently discarded; unresolved PCIe wording is recorded as uncovered until decided.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Ambiguous scope can hide a missing drive or validate the wrong device class; storage commands may be destructive.

project_override_considerations: A project decision may define HDD to include SATA, SAS, NVMe or selected managed devices and define Number as count, bay, slot, serial or namespace, but must explicitly dispose of the conflicting PCIe wording and document any uncovered branch.
expected_evidence: Engineering decision resolving scope and Number
Per-device Name, Status and resolved Number association
Same-host OS/controller/health comparison and preserved events
No-mutation proof and no hardware PASS claim

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Script target HDD/NVMe, while Procedure explicitly says PCIe card information, and Number has no defined semantic. Duplicate row 770 is separately isolated and does not resolve this internal conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The source decision and schema/topology are finite owner inputs. Execution must wait for them, but the case is not permanently impossible once supplied.

review_improvement: Prevents CPU sensor contamination, exposes the HDD/PCIe conflict and prohibits guessing the Number field or using a storage parser before scope is approved.
independent_technical_reasoning: The title, item and NVMe script suggest storage, but the explicit PCIe procedure cannot be overwritten by inference. A bounded engineering decision can resolve the branch; thereafter the read-only collection is automatable, supporting REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.
